packages.name: Relationships
packages.description: Factions, affinity, personality traits, PAD emotions, deeds, memories and gossip for NPCs. Requires Godot 4.7+.

packages.name: Save
packages.description: Slot files for game data, with timer autosave. Requires Godot 4.7+.

packages.name: Quests
packages.description: Hand-written and procedurally generated quests with a graph editor, givers, journal, HUD, indicators and save support. Integrates with Relationships when installed. Requires Godot 4.7+.

packages.name: Juice
packages.description: Game feel: tweens, shakes, flashes, hit stops, springs, sounds, rumble and floating text, played in sequence from a JuicePlayer. Requires Godot 4.7+.

packages.name: Behaviors
packages.description: Behavior trees with a graph editor, conditional aborts, shared variables, subtrees, utility AI, perception, steering and a live debugger. Integrates with Save, Relationships and Quests when installed. Requires Godot 4.7+.
